heading.subtitle: Expert Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer in Bandung, Indonesia

description: Hello! I'm Jamal Akbar Alam, a passionate full-stack developer and UI/UX designer based in Bandung, Indonesia. I'm the person who transforms beautiful designs into flawless, high-performance web applications that drive real business results.

With over 5 years of experience specializing in the Indonesian digital market, I build scalable web solutions, mobile applications, and e-commerce platforms that Indonesian and Southeast Asian users genuinely love. Based in Bandung, I understand the unique challenges and opportunities of the Indonesian tech ecosystem.

As Jamal Akbar Alam, I combine technical expertise with creative design thinking. For me, a project isn't complete until it's both visually stunning and technically perfect. My focus is on creating intuitive, accessible experiences that perform exceptionally well across all devices and internet conditions common in Indonesia.

I thrive on working with Indonesian businesses, startups, and enterprises who want to leverage cutting-edge technology to create innovative digital solutions that stand out in the competitive Indonesian market.
